rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst and correctly identifies a compact ICM and relatively looser TE, but it overstates visible TE detail and mentions a multilayered rim not clearly appreciable in this single image.

Integrates maternal age, BMI, PCOS, first-cycle status, endometrium, sperm parameters, and oocyte maturity with embryo quality and prognosis; AMH is unavailable but this is acknowledged implicitly by focusing on available data.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with age-related aneuploidy appropriately emphasized as the main limiter; minor issue is blending implantation and live birth probabilities into one range.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including cautious discussion of PGT-A and avoiding bed rest; slight overreach in protocol suggestions from limited cycle data prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and sensible future-cycle considerations such as protocol review, metabolic assessment, and selective sperm DNA fragmentation testing, though some advice remains somewhat general.
